messages:
tom (AE): Helix wants a 10-day POC to validate a custom Mistral-3B quantized variant for a customer-support chat product. They insist on private deployment (VPC) + SCIM + SSO, EU data residency, and an exec-level SLA. Can we scope compatibility + estimate?
leah (Sales-Eng): Call notes: target p95 latency <150ms for chat workloads (avg seq len ~256), expect 200-400 concurrent users during peak, embeddings for search may be requested later. They prefer q8_0 but can accept q4_0 if quality drops.
saurav (ML Eng): Compatibility checklist starting points: tokenizer type (sentencepiece/byte-level), special tokens, position embedding type (RoPE vs ALiBi), and whether the model uses fused attention or custom CUDA kernels. For Mistral-3B, typical memory w/ q8_0 ~8-12GB single-GPU; shardless possible. Need model.tar.gz with: 1) pytorch_state.bin 2) tokenizer.json 3) config.json 4) sample prompts + golden outputs.
rachel (Security): We got their security packet. They require SOC2-in-scope, SCIM, SSO (OIDC), customer-managed KMS, and forensic logs for 90d. Also note GDPR data-subject requests — need deletion workflow. Is on-prem mandatory or can we offer private-hosted within their VPC?
leah (Sales-Eng): We should present two POC options: (1) In-customer VPC deployment using our Private RPM (light install) — fastest for them to control keys, (2) Redwood-hosted private tenancy in eu-west region with CMK. Both can meet audit retention with log export.
tom (AE): They asked about cost model: monthly reserved vs POC flat fee + overage for hosted fallback. Also want token-level billing for hosted fallback.
saurav (ML Eng): For the POC I'll run a dry-run once they upload an 800MB subset. Performance suggestions: batch size 4 for <150ms p95, enable prefix KV-caching for repeated context, and disable flash-attention if custom kernels present. If they use custom fused ops we'll need build time for plugin -> extra ~3-5 days.
alex (Legal): For SLA during POC we can do a best-effort clause; for prod we need to lock latency/uptime metrics and a clear incident escalation path. I'll draft a short POC addendum. Any special IP clauses?
rachel (Security): Please confirm KMS flow: if they run in-customer VPC, keys remain in their KMS; for Redwood-hosted with CMK we can enable customer-managed keys (AWS KMS) with no escrow. I'll flag any gaps in the questionnaire.
tom (AE): Action items: 1) Saurav: define exact upload layout and presigned S3 instructions 2) Leah: prepare two POC quotes (VPC install + hosted private) with cost bands and time-to-kickoff 3) Rachel: security redlines 4) Alex: POC addendum draft.
saurav (ML Eng): Upload layout (example) -- please share exactly:
```
model-archive.tar.gz  # contains pytorch_model.bin, tokenizer.json, config.json
sample_prompts.jsonl  # 100 examples with expected replies
license.txt
checksums.sha256
```
We accept presigned S3 or direct SCP. Use sha256 checksums.
leah (Sales-Eng): Pricing notes: POC flat $12k for up to 10 days (includes infra and eng support), hosted fallback token billable at standard embedding/generation rates. VPC-install quote will include ops/day estimate and 2 cloud engineers for kickoff.
rachel (Security): Confirmed: SCIM + SSO supported. For deletion workflow, we provide a backfill + delete API we can run; need their legal to sign off on data retention SLA.
infra-bot: provision-request accepted: helix-poc-eu scheduled on 2xA100-80GB, 1xNAT-gateway, 50GB persistent logs. Deployment window 1746129000Z.
tom (AE): Please tag me when the presigned upload link and checklist are ready. I'll send the customer the POC options and target next-week start.
__notes: Slack thread JSON: single string of messages; metadata fields required by agents.md included.
